scope_notes: Diagrams are derived from .geninsights/analysis/analysis_results.json, business_rules.json, file-analysis-summary.md, and source verification.
This is an Allegro-oriented Swing/Vue/Node WebSocket prototype, not an HR system.
The two Swing entry points are separate implementations: websocket.Main receives WebSocket messages; com.Main launches the MVC-style com.poc HTTP submission flow.
The repository contains no implementation of the localhost:8080 /post endpoint. OpenAPI and Cucumber/RestAssured artifacts are a contract and test expectations, not server behavior.

Class summary counts Java class declarations, including nested classes, across application and test sources; interface and enum declarations are reported separately. Vue components and the Node relay script are documented as components, not Java classes.

class_diagrams.name: com.poc Swing MVC and submission classes
relationships: Main constructs and wires PocView, EventEmitter, PocModel, and PocPresenter
PocPresenter associates with PocView, PocModel, and EventEmitter
PocModel composes its enum-keyed ValueModel wrappers
PocModel associates with ModelProperties and EventEmitter and depends on HttpBinService

class_diagrams.name: WebSocket Swing receiver
relationships: websocket.Main depends on WebsocketClientEndpoint to connect to localhost:1337
WebsocketClientEndpoint depends on Message to extract the target/content envelope
WebsocketClientEndpoint depends on SearchResult to parse textfield message data

class_diagrams.name: API test support classes
relationships: PostStepDefinitions uses TestContext for scenario state
PostStepDefinitions uses ApiClient for HTTP requests
PostStepDefinitions depends on TestDataBuilder for named fixtures
TestDataBuilder creates its nested fluent Builder

sequence_diagrams.name: Search and transfer through the WebSocket relay
sequence_diagrams.workflow: Search local fixtures with OR criteria, select person and optional payment recipient, send a target/content envelope, relay to connected clients, and map recognized fields into the Swing form.

sequence_diagrams.name: Submit and reset the com.poc Swing form
sequence_diagrams.workflow: Bound controls update PocModel; action serializes all ModelProperties to strings, posts JSON, emits response-derived text, and presenter displays feedback and resets controls when the request returns normally.

sequence_diagrams.name: Cucumber API test request and assertions
sequence_diagrams.workflow: Scenario step definitions prepare fixture/data-table state, choose populated or empty JSON POST, call configured API through ApiClient, and assert response expectations; this does not represent a server implementation.

component_diagrams.name: Prototype components and actual boundaries
components: OpenAPI contract and API test project
relationships: Vue component searches in-memory fixtures and sends WebSocket JSON to Node relay
Node relay broadcasts received UTF-8 text to connected clients including sender
Java WebSocket Swing receiver maps recognized targets to its own form
com.poc model submits JSON to localhost:8080/post through HttpBinService
OpenAPI and API tests describe/assert an external endpoint; they do not implement it

use_case_diagrams.name: Prototype user goals and test-only endpoint interaction
use_cases: Transfer data to connected Swing form
Verify configured POST response expectations (test only)
